name: Title I Parent and Family Engagement Policy Distribution and Posting
description: After Board adoption, the Title I engagement policy is distributed in writing to all parents/family members, incorporated into the Title I Plan, and posted on the website.
preparedBy: District and each Title I school
deadline: following adoption of the Policy by the Board
quote: Following adoption of the Policy by the Board, the Policy shall be: Distributed in writing to all parents and family members.
